messages.author: Ingrid Voss
messages.text: The 03-05 supplemental file is quarantined: it landed 03:41, past cutoff. Most of it duplicates rows we already loaded — do not count the header number for anything.

messages.author: Femi Oyelaran
messages.text: Whatever goes in the pack must reconcile to Corin's control total. No hand edits to the mart, and any expedite fee goes through Ingrid, not me hearing about it later.

messages.author: Rei Tanaka
messages.text: Heads up: XL's night window Tuesday is the close certification load, protected as always.
